skill.name: daily-routine-note-move-tasks
skill.description: Ensure today's routine note exists and carry unchecked tasks from the last routine note.

skill:
task today,yesterday,move,carry,forward,unchecked,last routine
carry forward,carry-over,move unchecked,unchecked tasks
- Use `Today` and `Last routine note` paths from the routine hint. Do not search the vault for calendar yesterday. - If Last routine note is `Not created`, there is nothing to carry; create today's note only if missing, with `## Tasks` and no task lines.
- Walk the last routine note by `##` section, in file order. Do not flatten tasks across sections. - Keep a `## …` heading only if that section has at least one unchecked task line matching `- [ ] ...`. Copy the heading verbatim (`##` included). - Under that heading, copy those `- [ ]` lines verbatim. Drop checked tasks (`- [x]`), events, notes, and placeholder text in that section. - Omit empty `##` sections (no open `- [ ]` lines). Do not invent headings or rewrite `## Heading` as a bare title. - Do not move a task into another heading. - Tasks above the first `##` (if any) stay together under `## Tasks` only when they include `- [ ]` lines. - If the last routine note has no `##` headings, fall back to `## Tasks` plus the remaining `- [ ]` lines.
- Do not call `read_skill` for `daily-routine-note`. - Keep the last routine note unchanged. - Do not duplicate a task already present in today's note. - Do not call `create_new` when today's note already exists. - Do not flatten open tasks into a single list or dump them under the first heading. - Do not drop `##` from carried headings.
### Move unchecked tasks into today's note 1. In one turn, call `read_file` on today's path and, when Last routine note is not `Not created`, `read_file` on that path. 2. Build the carry-forward body from `` (section tree, not a flat task bag). 3. If today's note is missing, call `write_file` with `create_new` using that section tree. 4. If today's note exists, merge by heading: add missing `##` sections that still have open tasks; under an existing heading, append only `- [ ]` lines not already present. Use `overwrite` or `append` as needed. Do not append a flat list at the bottom. 5. Stop after that write, or if there is nothing to add. Do not search the vault or load another routine skill.
